data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall improvement on prior years' claims provisions of GBP 14.679m (a release equal to approximately 6.8% of opening gross claims outstanding). The improvement was driven by favourable prior-year development in Property (GBP 4.992m), Marine/Aviation & Transport (GBP 5.979m) and Energy (GBP 4.044m), partly offset by a small deterioration on reinsurance acceptances (GBP 0.248m). Named large losses from prior years (e.g. Guam Power, Australian hailstorms, Quilliq Energy) are cited as the larger items for closed years, while more recent 2016 events (Hurricane Matthew, pipeline and power losses) affected the 2015/2016 experience.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 14,679,000 on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Improvements of GBP 4,992,000 on fire and other damage to property, GBP 5,979,000 on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 4,044,000 on energy were partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 248,000 on reinsurance acceptances.
Reserves in respect of the 2013 and prior years of account continue to improve and develop satisfactorily, generating a surplus of GBP 12 million as at 31 December 2016.
